candidate_merges.message: Remove ASPIREAZURE003 from Azure role-assignment APIs (#20857) ## Description `AzureRoleAssignmentResource` is going stable: it is no longer experimental. Consumers can use this API without suppressing `ASPIREAZURE003`. Azure role assignments are not an Azure Networking feature, so the networking experimental diagnostic should not apply to this type. Remove its `Experimental` attribute and clean up obsolete suppressions in `RoleAssignmentResourceAnnotation`, the shared ACR pull identity helper,
